dogs.name: Parker
bio: Looking for a little love, a lot of loyalty, and plenty of tail wags? Parker might just be your guy!

This handsome boy has a heart full of love and a special talent for making his people feel like the center of his world. He bonds quickly and deeply with those he loves, and once you're in his inner circle, you'll have a devoted best friend for life.
Parker is a smart cookie and knows his basic commands. He's ready to show off his good-boy manners at your Thanksgiving gathering!
Parker joined POMDR after his guardian passed away and is now looking for a loving home where he can continue to be someone's loyal companion.

dogs.name: Pumpkin
bio: This little cutie is sweeter than a caramel apple and sure to cast a spell on your heart! With a name as cozy as a crisp fall day and a personality that's pure Halloween magic, Pumpkin is ready to make every day feel like a trip to the pumpkin patch. Whether it's snuggling up on a chilly autumn evening, going on leaf-crunching adventures, or handing out plenty of tricks and treats (mostly treats!), Pumpkin is sure to bring a little extra magic wherever those paws go. Forget spooky season, it's snuggle season with Pumpkin!
Pumpkin gets along well with other dogs and would be so pleased to find a home where she can rest with ease. She enjoys gentle walks, lounging around, and keeping her people happy and sound!

Pumpkin joined us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after being found as a stray. Due to overcrowding, the shelter reached out to us for help, and we were happy to welcome this sweet girl into our care. Now, Pumpkin is ready for her next chapter and the chance to find a loving forever home!

dogs.name: Grim
bio: With a name like Grim, you might expect a mysterious phantom or a fearsome creature of the night, but this Grim is anything but scary. Grim is sweet as pie and would much rather collect cuddles and treats than haunt the neighborhood, and he's ready to cast a spell on his forever family.

If you're looking for a loyal companion who will make every day feel like a little bit of magic, Grim may be your perfect match. He's hoping to trade his shelter stay for a cozy home, a comfy bed, and a family to love forever.
Grim joined Peace of Mind Dog Rescue from Hitchcock Road Animal Services, where his senior status made him a good fit for our program.

dogs.name: Tofurky
bio: Move over Thanksgiving dinner, there's a new Tofurky in town, and he's WAY cuter than anything you'll find on the holiday table! Tofurky is a silly little lad with adorable wiry hair, a whole lot of personality, and enough spunk to keep life entertaining. He's a happy, sweet little guy who loves just about everyone he meets, both two-legged and four-legged friends alike. He's also a big fan of lap time, snuggles, and being right where the action is (preferably in your arms!).

With his charming looks, playful spirit, and affectionate nature, Tofurky is quite the little package. He's got all the fixings of a wonderful companion and is ready to find his forever home. No leftovers here... Tofurky is the whole feast!
Tofurky joined us from Silicon Valley Animal Control and Authority after he was picked up as a stray. They felt that he would do best with POMDR to find a senior-dog savvy adopter!

dogs.name: Fawn
bio: Meet Fawn, a sweet little gentleman with a name as cute as he is! Gentle and tender, he gets along wonderfully with other dogs and brings a soft, happy charm wherever he goes.

Fawn's happiest curled up close, soaking in all the cuddles and human affection he can get. Looking for a loving companion with the heart of a baby deer? This adorable boy is ready to fawn all over you!
Fawn joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray.

dogs.name: Tarzan and Jane
bio: Meet Tarzan & Jane! Twice the Love, Double the Joy! Tarzan and Jane are a bonded pair with hearts as big as their personalities. If you're looking for loyal companions who will fill your home with love, laughter, and unconditional affection, these two are ready to meet you.

Jane is the ultimate cuddle bug. She loves curling up next to her people and would happily spend an evening snuggled on the couch-or better yet, on your lap. Although she has very limited vision (okay, she's basically blind) she doesn't let it define her. She enjoys going for walks and, once she learns her surroundings, gets around remarkably well. Like all of us, she's not perfect, but her resilience, gentle spirit, and loving heart shine through every day.

Tarzan is full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He has one hilarious superpower: if there's an open car door, don't be surprised if he launches himself into the seat like a little Superman, convinced it's time for a road trip! To Tarzan, every car ride is another chance to be with his favorite people, and his excitement is impossible not to love.

Together, they're the perfect team. They adore each other, but they also have a funny little rivalry over one very important prize-your lap! What makes Tarzan and Jane truly special isn't just their bond with each other-it's how completely they love their humans. Whether they're joining you for a neighborhood stroll, riding shotgun on an adventure, or simply relaxing at home, they're happiest when they're by your side.

These two don't need a perfect family-because none of us are perfect. They simply need someone willing to love them for who they are. In return, they'll give you unwavering loyalty, endless affection, daily laughter, and the kind of companionship that only dogs who know they've found home can offer.
If you have room in your heart for two incredible dogs, Tarzan and Jane are ready to fill your life with twice the love, twice the joy, and a lifetime of unforgettable moments.

Tarzan and Jane joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services. They were picked up as strays. Due to their senior status and Jane's vision impairments, they felt they would do best in the hands of a senior rescue.

dogs.name: Licorice
bio: Looking for a little extra sweetness in your life? Meet Licorice! This adorable boy is bringing all the fall charm with none of the sugar rush. He's a toy-loving sweetheart who enjoys making furry friends and gets along well with other dogs. With just the right balance of playful energy and laid-back charm, Licorice is always up for some fun but is equally happy to kick back and enjoy the cozy side of life.

Imagine coming home to a wagging tail, a playful companion ready to share in your adventures, and a sweet boy who's just as content snuggling into a relaxing afternoon. That's Licorice! If you're looking for a companion who brings a little fun, a lot of sweetness, and plenty of love to every day, he might be the perfect addition to your family.
Licorice joined POMDR from Los Banos Animal Shelter, where he was brought in as a stray.

dogs.name: Gabby
bio: Gorgeous Gabby may be enjoying her golden years, but this sweet senior Schnoodle still has plenty of pep in her step! She loves her daily walks, basking in the sunshine, and staying close to her people for gentle pets and affection. With her moderate energy level, Gabby is the perfect companion for someone who enjoys a leisurely stroll followed by a cozy cuddle session on the couch.

Gabby is as easygoing as they come. She gets along wonderfully with both dogs and cats, making her a great fit for many types of homes. She isn't demanding or overbearing - just a calm, loving presence with soulful eyes that have a way of capturing everyone's heart. Gabby is also delightfully quiet, usually only offering a bark or two every few days when she's hoping for a little extra attention.

One of Gabby's many wonderful qualities is that she is fully housetrained, according to her foster. In fact, she arrived without even a single accident, which is a rare and impressive testament to what a good girl she is.

Since arriving, Gabby has been receiving the medical care she needs to help her feel her best. She is currently being treated for Cushing's disease and is working toward losing approximately 9 pounds. Her weight loss journey will take time, even with reduced calories, and may require several months of patience and consistency. Reaching a healthier weight is an important step before she can safely undergo a dental cleaning and have a couple of lipomas removed.

Gabby is also an enthusiastic eater and has a habit of consuming things she shouldn't. Her future family will need to provide a safe environment by keeping potentially harmful items out of reach, including products such as snail or rat bait.

Gabby is a special senior girl who deserves a home where her health needs are understood and where she can spend her days feeling safe, loved, and cherished. If you believe life's sweetest companions only get better with age, Gabby is ready to show you just how wonderful a senior dog can be.
Gabby joined the POMDR pack after her loving guardian was no longer able to care for her.

dogs.name: Evie
bio: Meet Evie, a whole lotta love wrapped up in one adorable potato of a Pittie! This sweet senior lady is as lovely as they come. Evie seems to think everyone she meets is a friend just waiting to happen, whether they have two legs or four! She's happy to make friends with dogs, kids, and even cats!

Evie is also a wonderful walking buddy! She's great on leash and would probably be thrilled to add a few more strolls to her daily routine. A little fresh air, some quality time with her people, and plenty of affection sound like Evie's idea of a pretty perfect life. And with a face that sweet and a body built for maximum snuggling, we suspect she'd be an excellent couch companion, too. If you're looking for a friendly, easygoing girl with a big heart and a little extra potato to love, Evie might just be your perfect match!
Evie joined Peace of Mind Dog Rescue after her guardian passed away.

dogs.name: Edgar Allan Paw
bio: Edgar Allan Paw is more about living his stories to the fullest than reading them. This guy is full of spunk and love. He loves playing with other dogs, then cuddling up with you. He isn't writing horror stories, but adventures! Find him running alongside you or taking in the sights. He doesn't seem to know he's a senior pup!

Edgar Allan Paw settles in quickly and greets every person with enthusiasm and love. He joined POMDR from Sacramento Animal Care and Regulation when they determined his senior status would make him a better fit here.

dogs.name: Salem
bio: Looking for a little bit of magic this Halloween? Meet Salem! With his inky-black coat, snowy little markings, and big soulful eyes, Salem looks like he stepped straight out of a Halloween storybook. But this sweet Maltese mix isn't here to cast any spells. He's just looking for someone to cast a little love his way.

Salem is the perfect size for cozying up beside you and would love to find a forever home where he can enjoy all the good things in life: soft beds, leisurely days, plenty of attention, and a family to call his own. No tricks, just treats: Salem is ready to make his happily-ever-after happen. Could you be the person he's been waiting for?
Salem came to us from Bradshaw Animal Shelter in Sacramento after being found as a stray.

dogs.name: Barbara Walters
bio: Barbara Walters is just as charismatic and personable as her namesake! She's the perfect size to sit by your side and bend an ear (or both ears!) and she's still got plenty of spunk and moxie!

She enjoys interviewing adults, children, and other dogs, though she's yet to meet a cat. She is also crate-trained and knows her basic commands. Barbara is still peppy and ready to get back into interview shape! Lights! Camera! Foster!
Barbara Walters joined POMDR after her guardian was no longer able to care for her.
dogs.sponsors: Briana and Brian Sanford, Jen Snow, Daniela Cuevas-Garcia

dogs.name: Mustard
bio: Meet Mustard! She's got just the right amount of sweetness and spice to match her name. Small but full of personality, she has a soft, charming presence and that classic little-dog confidence that says she knows exactly how cute she is.
She's the kind of pup who's happiest nestled close to her people, soaking up affection, and being part of whatever's going on, preferably from a cozy lap or a sunny spot nearby.
Mustard came to us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after she was picked up as a stray.

dogs.name: Guppy
bio: Guppy is true to his roots, blending the energetic, playful spirit often seen in a Border Collie with the loyal, protective qualities of a Shepherd-type dog. He thrives when he has both physical activity and mental engagement in his day; whether that's a lively game of fetch, exploring new environments, or simply being your trusty sidekick on everyday adventures. He also has a softer side and enjoys winding down with his person, happily settling in for snuggles after a full day of fun.
Guppy is a sweet guy, but tends to be too excited by cats and would not be suited to live with them. Any doggie siblings need to be carefully considered and introduced to ensure a good match.

Guppy is a smart boy and knows cues like "sit," "down," "paw," and even "other paw!" He likes to be a watchdog and may bark at passers-by, but is easily distracted with treats or affection. A true lover, his favorite place to sleep is next to you, preferably under the blankets. His best friend--apart from you--is his beloved squeaky toy, which he loves to chase in the morning and place in a safe spot when he's not playing. He's great at communicating and will lean his head against your legs for pets. Once he gets to know you, he'll plop over on his back for belly rubs and will kick his leg if you scratch just the right spot. You know he's relaxing when you hear his signature long grumble as he settles down.

We are looking for an experienced adopter because while Guppy is a calm, sweet dog most of the time, he has had occasional moments of aggression while being handled. X-rays revealed significant arthritis of the spine and we think this may have contributed to these behavior incidents. Guppy is now on an anti-inflammatory and pain medication and is back to his happy, loving self.

We do think it he would do best in a quiet female only home as he seems to prefer women over men. He has come a long way and now does well on walks, preferring to go at his own pace and sniff every flower. With patience and time, he has warmed up to strangers, but on occasion, he will still bark at dogs or people. He also needs to be mindfully introduced to guests; after all, his number one priority is keeping his home safe! Once he feels safe, he'll find a cozy spot beside, beneath, or on top of you.

Guppy came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Shelter after being found as a stray. He is now looking for a committed, experienced, and patient home that can continue to help him thrive while respecting his needs and boundaries. With the right understanding and structure, Guppy has so much potential, and he's ready for a person who can appreciate both his joy and his complexity.

dogs.name: Thistle
bio: Tiny Thistle is a sweet little autumn treasure with a gentle, mellow nature and a heart loaded with love. Just like the soft, silvery plant she's named after, Thistle is delicate, charming, and quietly beautiful. She's an easy keeper who enjoys the simple things in life: cozy naps, kind companionship, and being close to her people.

Thistle gets along wonderfully with other dogs and will likely do well with cats, too. She doesn't need much, just a warm, loving place to call home and someone who will cherish her as much as she deserves. If you're looking for a gentle little companion to add some sweetness to your days, Thistle may be your perfect match.
Thistle joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after she was found as a stray. Due to her senior status, they felt she would do best in a senior-focused rescue.

dogs.name: Capri Sun
bio: Capri Sun is a sweet, easygoing boy who gets along well with other dogs and seems content to just go with the flow. Whether you're hanging out on the couch or heading out for a stroll, he's happy to be along for the adventure. We don't know much about Capri Sun's past, but we know he's looking forward to a future filled with love, treats, belly rubs, and a family to call his own.

He's the kind of pup who doesn't need much to be happy, just a cozy spot, squeaky toys, and someone to love. He enjoys playing by himself, but also likes cuddles and attention from both dog and human friends. He loves a good walk and has a peppy trot. His back end is a little weak, so he prefers to walk slower, but he doesn't mind being carried when the time calls for it.
Capri Sun's ideal day involves lots of playtime with his favorite people nearby, a nice walk, then naps. He would also love to have a few treats sprinkled throughout.
Capri Sun came from Front Street Animal Shelter when it was determined he would be a good fit for the POMDR program.

dogs.name: Mihla
bio: Don't let her frosted gray coat fool you, this 8 year old is pure sunshine around those she loves. A copilot extraordinaire, this trusty girl loves being a passenger princess (just don't ask her to back up the trailer.) She's a wonderful walk companion and trail guide, who takes great joy in pointing out the local flora and fauna to her companions. She took up knitting while waiting for her forever home to find her, after 731+ days at it, her scarf now qualifies for a Guinness book world record but she's holding out hope!

Miss Mihla enjoys spending her time going for car rides or long walks, playing surgeon with squeaky toys, alerting her fosters about squirrels and birds that dare to cross her path, and attending training regularly to work on building up her leash manners.

This lovely lady would be ideal for a home where she can be the star and not have to share your attention but she may also fit right in with a household that has a mellow dog who doesn't mind sharing the spotlight. Due to how excited we have seen her get around prey animals we suspect she may not be ideal for a household with cats. We have not seen how she is with children.

The SPCA of Monterey County reached out to us for help because Mihla was becoming increasingly stressed in the shelter environment. She was a favorite among many volunteers who worked with her there, so how could we resist?

dogs.name: Cream Cheese
bio: We're still getting to know miss Cream Cheese but what we do know is that she's a lovely lady who enjoys the company of people and other dogs. With her fluffy coat, gentle senior-dog charm, and a name this delicious, Cream Cheese is pretty much impossible not to love. We have a feeling this big, beautiful girl has plenty of sweetness to share and we can't wait to see her blossom as she settles into her next home. Maybe with you?
Miss Cream Cheese joins us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after she was picked up as a stray. Due to her senior status, they felt she was best suited to join a senior focused rescue.

dogs.name: Rita
bio: Rita is a gal with a heart full of love and a calm, easygoing charm. She's the kind of companion who's happiest in the simple moments: cozy snuggles, gentle strolls, and quietly keeping you company just because she loves being near you. Rita is always ready to settle in close at your feet, beside you on the couch, or wherever her favorite person happens to be. She doesn't ask for much, just your presence, patience, and a soft spot to land. She's cat friendly and has done well living with feline housemates.

Rita is gentle and sensitive and prefers not to be picked up or moved abruptly, and with consistency and care, she settles in beautifully. Her twice-daily medication is part of her routine and she does well when it's thoughtfully tucked into meals.

Rita came to POMDR after her guardian moved into assisted living and could no longer care for her. Now she's ready for her next chapter,a quiet, loving home where she can share her steady devotion, soft companionship, and endless sweetness.

dogs.name: Jason
bio: Jason is a gentle soul who needs a little extra time and a whole lot of understanding to feel safe in the world. He's a timid boy who is still learning to trust, and he'll need a patient person who is happy to let him move at his own pace. Jason isn't ready to hit the walking trails just yet, and he may never be the adventurous, leash-walking type. But with time, kindness, and a little encouragement, he may surprise us! For now, his happy place is somewhere safe and cozy, with the freedom to take each new step when he's ready.

One of the best things about Jason is how wonderful he is with other dogs! In fact, having a confident canine companion (or even a whole pack!) in his next home is a must for this boy. He takes comfort in his fellow pups and can learn so much by watching them navigate the world. He also does well with kitties, making him a lovely candidate for a home with feline friends, too.

Jason is looking for someone who understands that progress doesn't always happen overnight. He may need extra time to settle in and build trust, but for the right person, helping him discover that the world can be a safe and happy place will be a very special journey.
Jason joined Peace of Mind Dog Rescue from Hitchcock Road Animal Services, where his senior status made him a good fit for our program.

dogs.name: Barnabas
bio: Introducing Barnabas, the most charming "vampire" you will ever meet! With his soft, curly cream coat and gentle eyes, this sweet boy is far more interested in stealing your favorite spot on the couch than casting any spells. Barnabas is a gentle soul who loves human affection, making him the perfect companion to keep you warm and cozy all year round.
Barnabas joins us from San Jose Animal Care & Services. Due to his senior status, they felt that he would do best in a rescue setting to find his forever home.

dogs.name: Hocus
bio: This handsome little heart-stealer is here to cast a spell on everyone he meets! With a name like Hocus, you know he's got a few tricks up his furry sleeves and a whole lot of magic in his paws. Whether he's conjuring up cuddles, enchanting you with those puppy-dog eyes, or magically appearing whenever treats are involved, this boy is full of Halloween charm! He's the perfect mix of spooky-season mischief and cozy fall sweetness, ready to turn ordinary days into a little hocus-pocus of happiness. One wag of his tail, and poof! You're under his spell!

This sweet little guy is happiest when he's surrounded by love! He gets along nicely with other dogs, but nothing compares to cuddling up with his favorite people and soaking in every bit of affection they have to offer. With a heart full of love and snuggles to spare, he's ready to leave his spooky past behind and start a brand new chapter. Forget the tricks; this adorable boy is all treat and is hoping his forever family is just around the corner!

Hocus joined us from Elk Grove Animal Services after being found as a stray. Due to overcrowding, the shelter reached out to us for help, and we were happy to welcome this sweet guy into our care. Now, Hocus is ready for his next chapter and the chance to find a loving forever home!

dogs.name: Pocus
bio: Meet Pocus, a spirited young girl with a whole lot of personality and a little magic up her sleeve! She's currently recovering from a broken arm, but don't let that fool you. This youngster hasn't lost her zest for life one bit. Pocus is proof that a little setback can't dim a big, happy spirit!

As she continues to heal, Pocus is looking forward to a bright future filled with love, comfort, and all the happy adventures that await her. She may need a little extra TLC while she recovers and would benefit from training, but she has plenty of sweetness to give in return. With her resilient spirit and youthful charm, Pocus is ready to cast a spell on someone's heart and find her very own happily ever after!
Pocus would do best in a home without young children. She has previously lived with a cat.

Pocus joined us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after being found as a stray. Due to overcrowding, the shelter reached out to us for help, and we were happy to welcome this sweet girl into our care. Now, Pocus is ready for her next chapter and the chance to find a loving forever home!

dogs.name: Van Helsing
bio: Don't let the name fool you! Van Helsing isn't hunting vampires; he's hunting for cuddles, cozy laps, and a forever home! This charming little man may have a name fit for a spooky legend, but there's nothing scary about his sweet personality! Van Helsing arrived at the shelter severely matted and in desperate need of some TLC. But you'd never guess he'd had a rough start by his incredibly happy spirit and irresistible charm!

Van Helsing is a friendly little fellow who gets along well with other dogs, but his true passion is soaking up all the love and attention he can get from his favorite humans. He's a professional snuggler with a heart of gold, and he's ready to put his spooky past behind him! No tricks here, just one very sweet treat waiting for his happily ever after!

Van Helsing joined us from Bradshaw County Animal Services after he was found as a stray, horribly matted and in need of some care. Due to his senior status and the state of neglect he had suffered, they felt he would do best to find his forever family with a senior focused rescue.

dogs.name: Potion
bio: Just in time for Halloween, Potion is brewing up something special! This enchanting girl has a magical way of capturing hearts, and one look into her adorable eyes is all it takes to fall under her spell. She won't need a magic wand to make your heart melt; she has plenty of love to share!

Potion gets along with just about everyone and is ready to sprinkle a little magic into her forever family's life. From cozy cuddles to loyal companionship and unforgettable memories, this sweet girl is ready to make every day feel a little more magical. If you've been searching for a love potion of your own, Potion just might be the perfect match!

Potion joined us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after being found as a stray. Due to overcrowding, the shelter reached out to us for help, and we were happy to welcome this sweet girl into our care. Now, Potion is ready for her next chapter and the chance to find a loving forever home!

dogs.name: Boots
bio: Boots is ready to step right into your heart! This adorable pup is full of charm, sweetness, and a lovable personality, making every day feel a little brighter. He may be a little banged up right now and in need of some extra TLC to get him feeling his best, but he is already putting his best paw forward. Whether he's happily trotting by your side or cozying up for some quality cuddle time, Boots is sure to be your favorite companion.

If you're looking for a loyal friend who is ready to walk into a forever home, Boots may be the perfect fit! He has his paws pointed in the right direction and is hoping to find someone who will love him through every adventure, rainy-day stroll, and cozy night in. With Boots by your side, every step is sure to be a happy one!

Boots joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray. Due to his medical needs and senior status, they felt POMDR would be the perfect place for him to start his next chapter.

dogs.name: Mattie aka Matteo
bio: Mattie is a sweet little lamb, following his foster people around the house hoping for snacks! He was in ruff shape when he came to POMDR, but with the loving care of his foster family and attention to his medical needs, he has become a new dog! We have determined that Mattie is hard of hearing, but you wouldn't notice it for how attentive he is to his surroundings.
He is on inexpensive medications for Cushing's disease and low thyroid. Luckily, he is a champ at taking his meds!

He does very well around other dogs and is super food motivated! Besides meal time and snack time, Mattie also loves his naps. He loves to wander around the yard and explore the house. He doesn't really need leash walks. He gets his steps in around the house! He does just fine being left at home, and would likely get along fine with cat friends.

Mattie joined us from Los Banos Animal Services after being found as a stray. They realized it was in Mattie's best interest to land with a senior dog rescue. We're happy to report that Mattie is on the path to a whole new life! Can you be his forever home?

dogs.name: Miko
bio: Miko is a happy, affectionate boy who enthusiastically greets everyone he meets with a joyful tail wag. He gets along well with other dogs and would love to find a family ready to enjoy plenty of walks, cuddles, and companionship. Miko would make a wonderful walking partner and a fantastic addition to just about any home!

If you're looking for a loving pup with a cheerful spirit and plenty of affection to share, Miko may be your perfect match. He's ready to bring happy tail wags, sweet moments, and lots of love to his forever family!
Miko joined POMDR from the SPCA of Monterey County when it was determined that his senior status made him a good fit for our program.

dogs.name: Bagel Boss
bio: Bagel Boss is sweet, happy, and ready to snuggle up! He loves people and is good with dogs, though he is not very interested in them. He has some pep and is playful, but knows how to settle, especially when his people are gone -- though he would prefer you to stay around!
Bagel Boss enjoys toys, and his ideal day would be playtime followed by naps and snuggles. Want a trusty companion? Bagel Boss is your pup!
Bagel Boss joined POMDR after his guardian passed away.

dogs.name: Zero
bio: Zero is a charming boy. Despite being attacked by a dog, he remains sweet and docile. He is looking for a special someone who can help him recover. In return, you get his adoration and love. He just needs a place to curl up so he can become himself again.

Zero joined POMDR from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray. Due to his severe wounds and need for emergency medical care, he was transferred to POMDR. He is now stable, recovering, and searching for his foster.

dogs.name: Teddy
bio: Teddy is proof that great things can come in small packages. At 21lbs, Teddy makes a great travel companion. His loving nature means he greets people and dogs with wiggles and wags! At home, he enjoys lounging by your side or outdoors in the sunshine. While he does prefer to be with you, he does fine when left home alone, finding a spot to settle and wait.
Teddy still has plenty of love left to give. Not only is he great with children, but he helped his previous guardian raise their children! He truly knows how to be part of the family.
Teddy is joining POMDR after his guardian went through a heartbreaking divorce and could no longer care for him. He is ready to enjoy his retirement with a little play and lots of love and snuggles.

dogs.name: Kelpie
bio: Kelpie is a happy-go-lucky little guy with a smile that never quits and energy to match! He is a pure Energizer bunny! This scruffy sweetheart is full of charm and is always ready to brighten your day with his cheerful personality. He's an active guy who loves playtime and walks.

Whether he's trotting along on a stroll or curling up for a cozy nap, Kelpie is simply happy to be by your side. Kelpie could use a little extra guidance. While he typically gets along with dogs, he is leash reactive, and he takes a little while to warm up to strangers. Kelpie would do best with an experienced guardian who is ready to show him the world isn't so scary! He likes to communicate with his mouth, so he would do best in an adult-only home.
Kelpie came to us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after his guardian could no longer care for him.

dogs.name: Leaf
bio: Leaf is a happy-go-lucky, loving, and affectionate Lady who knows how to keep herself busy. She has an affinity for piles of pillows and fluffy blankets with which she will build a cozy nest for naptime. After resting, she enjoys long, fast-paced walks, extensive yard explorations, sunbathing, and chasing squirrels. She loves being around her people, but also does not mind being home alone for a bit. On car rides, Leaf is well-behaved and quietly sits in the passenger seat. She would be happiest in a home without cats and where she is the only dog. While she tolerates most small, easygoing pups, she really isn't too fond of bigger dogs who tower over her. Her favorite indoor surfaces to walk on are carpet, rugs, or tile; wood floors not so much.

Leaf is more than ready to meet her forever family! She will be right by your side while you sip a cup of tea and watch the foliage change colors outside your window. She is the most cheerful little companion that anyone could ever ask for. Be-Leaf is her motto!
Lovely Leaf joined POMDR from San Jose Animal Care and Services after she was picked up as a stray.

dogs.name: Sparkler
bio: Sparkler has a way of making everything around her feel a little brighter, just like a warm summer evening filled with laughter, ice cream, and a little bit of magic in the air. This cheerful Lady is easygoing, affectionate, and happy to take life at a mellow pace. She makes it her business to know everything that is going on around the house and the yard, and she will be your faithful shadow throughout the day... unless she is taking one of her frequent beauty naps.

Sparkler gets along well with all people, other dogs, as well as with cats, and she brings a calm, friendly presence wherever she goes. She is quite independent and easily adjusts to new surroundings and circumstances. She loves food and snacks and will perform a happy, twirly dance when she thinks that dinner should be served at any time now. With her fluffy, sparkly coat, darling face, and soft, soulful eyes, she is impossible not to fall in love with. Sparkler currently has monthly appointments with an oncologist to keep a growth in her bladder at bay.
Sweet Sparkler joined us after she was found as a stray and brought to Hitchcock Road Animal Services. They felt she would do best in a senior focused rescue to find her forever family.
dogs.sponsors: Amanda Nixon in honor of Anna

dogs.name: Wave
bio: Meet Wave, a sweet senior lady with a gentle heart and irresistible personality. Though her vision is limited, she navigates the world with quiet confidence and an open heart. She loves soft voices, kind hands, and the comfort of simply being near her people, soaking up affection wherever she finds it.

Wave is an easygoing, affectionate girl who enjoys the simple things in life - cozy naps, gentle pets, and calm companionship. She's the kind of dog who settles right into your space and makes it feel warmer just by being there. Friendly and loving, she greets new friends with a soft tail wag and a trusting spirit that shines through.

This golden girl is ready for a peaceful forever home where she can be cherished and cared for. Her vision impairment just means she appreciates a steady routine and a little guidance, but what she gives in return is pure devotion. Wave is ready to fill someone's life with quiet joy, soft moments, and unconditional love.
Wave joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being brought to the shelter as a stray.

dogs.name: Cola
bio: Cola is the kind of guy who makes himself at home wherever his people are. Sweet, social, and wonderfully easygoing, he enjoys leisurely walks and little adventures, and is equally talented at settling in for a good nap afterward. Basically, he has mastered the art of enjoying all facets of life!

Cola gets along beautifully with other dogs and would be happy to share his home with a canine companion. He's currently working on fine-tuning his leash skills and greetings, and he can't wait to show you what he's learned. This friendly fellow believes making new friends is one of life's great pleasures, and he brings plenty of happy enthusiasm to every introduction!

Cola came to POMDR from The Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire when overcrowding left several dogs in need of somewhere to go. Now this charming little gentleman is ready to snuggle into the comfort and companionship of a home of his own, with his favorite people right there beside him to enjoy it all.

dogs.name: Zephyr (was Sonny)
bio: Zephyr is a special senior who needs a soft landing with a caring, patient adopter. Zephyr was recently surrendered back to POMDR when his senior guardian could no longer care for him. He had been with her for three years. The transition has been a little tough on him and we are giving him some time to decompress and show his true personality.

What we do know so far is he enjoys a good walkabout and sniff in the yard, then settles down well in a cozy bed where he may nap or take in the world around him. He isn't ready for a lot of cuddle time or petting. Zephyr lives with 4 other dogs in his foster home and gets along well. We are looking for a special home that can provide him with a soft place to land.

This sweet senior gentleman originally joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services as a medical intake. He arrived at the shelter not bearing any weight on his right hind leg. Thankfully, this has since resolved although he does still have a slight limp.

dogs.name: Biggie
bio: Biggie is a professional snuggler with a big personality and an even bigger appreciation for being close to his people. This affectionate Pug loves everyone he meets, including children, and is happiest curled up beside you, snoozing in your lap, or following along to see what the day has in store. He's wonderfully adaptable, equally content enjoying a walk, exploring the beach, soaking up some backyard sunshine, or spending a lazy afternoon on the couch. He also loves stuffed toys, tug-of-war, treats, and providing plenty of entertainment with his signature Pug snorts and snores.

Biggie is blind, but he navigates his world impressively well and loves getting out for walks and adventures with a little guidance from his person. He would especially enjoy a home where someone is around often and looking for a devoted companion.
Biggie joined POMDR after his senior guardian could no longer care for him. Now he's ready to bring his cuddles, charm, and unmistakably sparkling personality to a home of his own.

dogs.name: Bones
bio: Meet Bones, a scruffy little sweetheart with the biggest, most soulful eyes you've ever seen! With his delightfully messy coat and adorable wispy ears, this gentle guy looks like a real-life plush toy. Don't let his spooky name fool you, Bones is all about sweetness and is looking for a warm lap to curl up in and a forever family to love.
Bones joins us from San Jose Animal Care & Services. Due to his senior status, they felt that he would do best in a rescue setting to find his forever home.

dogs.name: Loretta
bio: Loretta is ready to trade in her "rough around the edges" days for a life of cozy beds, gentle TLC, and being thoroughly spoiled. Loretta seems to have lived a tough life in the past and she's definitely in need of a little makeover and some extra love. She could use a nice bath, a good groom, a soft place to curl up, and most importantly, a person who will remind her just how wonderful she is.

Despite whatever she's been through, Loretta is an absolute sweetheart. She's easygoing, gentle, and gets along well with other dogs. She doesn't ask for much- just a comfy bed, some tasty snacks, a little companionship, and someone who will make sure she feels safe and loved from here on out.

Miss Loretta joins us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after she was found as a stray. Due to her medical need and her senior status, they felt that she would do best in a rescue setting to find her forever home.

dogs.name: Pocket
bio: Pocket is compact, endearing, and precious, just like a little, magical treasure. With his scruffy good looks, this bundle of joy brings happiness into hearts and homes. His favorite pastimes include soaking up all the belly rubs he can possibly get, zooming through the yard, squeaking his squeaky toys, chasing squirrels, softly howling with emergency vehicle sirens, and showing off his tiny-but-mighty superstar energy. He is playful, silly, and always up for a little fun. Pocket is perfectly house-trained, well-behaved during bath time, and greets you with excitement whenever you get home. His foster family reports that he is a great companion on long road trips and that he is especially adorable first thing in the morning when he snuggles his face against you to show his deep affection.

Pocket prefers to be around adult humans and thrives when he can be the apple of your eye all day, every day. With his senior status comes the privilege of being a bit set in his ways and knowing what he wants; thus, for his golden years, he is looking for a loving adult-only, single-dog, feline-free household where yummy treats and sweet snuggles are plentiful. This guy will have you in his pocket in no time.
Pocket joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after his guardian lost their housing.

dogs.name: Kenji
bio: Kenji is a total sweetheart with the perfect mix of playful energy and laid-back charm! He's got a heart of gold, a tail that lets you know he's always happy to see you, and a serious love for his fellow four-legged friends. Kenji is a social butterfly who enjoys canine company and is always up for making new buddies.

With his loving nature and easygoing spirit, Kenji would make a wonderful companion for someone looking to add a little extra joy to their life. He's ready to share plenty of tail wags, cuddles, and unconditional love with his forever family!
Kenji came to us after his guardian found they could no longer care for their dogs and surrendered them to a local shelter.

dogs.name: Lacey
bio: Lacey is a sweet little soul who has perfected the art of taking life easy. Her ideal day includes a short walk, a good meal, plenty of naps, and following her favorite person from room to room. She may be reserved when first meeting new people, but once she knows you, expect happy tail wags, excited little tippy-tappies, and the occasional surprise case of the zoomies! Lacey walks nicely on leash and gets along well with dogs, cats, and even the farm animals she has met.

Lacey has significant hearing loss, so she appreciates a calm home where her people approach her gently and help her know what's happening around her. She would especially enjoy an adult household with someone who is home often. She is wonderfully low-key, rarely vocal, and happiest snoozing nearby while you go about your day.
Lacey was dearly loved by her previous guardian and rescuer and is now ready for her next chapter filled with soft beds, leisurely walks, good snacks, and a favorite person to keep company.

dogs.name: Tulle
bio: Tulle is a sweet little dog with a gentle charm that makes her impossible not to love. She has an adorable presence and a soft, endearing personality that will quickly win your heart. Tulle enjoys being around her people and would love nothing more than to find a family where she can feel safe, loved, and cherished.

With her sweet nature and lovable personality, Tulle is ready to leave shelter life behind and begin her next chapter. If you're looking for a darling little companion who will bring plenty of affection and happiness into your life, Tulle may be the girl you've been waiting for!
Tulle came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after her guardian passed.

dogs.name: Bel Air
bio: If a sweet Schnauzer is the dog you've been dreaming of, Bel Air (aka "Miss Manners") is here! Social, stylish, and active, Bel Air is your perfect companion for adventures of all kinds, from exploring the outdoors to lounging on the couch! She loves human company, interacts well with other dogs, and flaunts her beautiful silver coat with pride!

Bel Air is just about the most loving and considerate dog out there. Curling up on your lap makes her quite happy. She'll even jump into the laps of strangers! Bel Air is a cardio queen - she walks two miles at a time and stops to check out wildlife and greet other dogs on the way! Bel Air enjoys exploring the beach, trails, or the neighborhood! She also loves car rides. Her pastimes include playing with toys, munching on treats, and doing happy dances when you get home! Bel Air is house-trained and crate-trained. She knows basic commands but doesn't enjoy sitting often due to stiff back legs. She is generally quiet and is comfortable with typical household noise.
Bel Air comes to us from Animal Care and Services of San Jose after being found as a stray.

dogs.name: Tuxedo
bio: Tuxedo is suited up and ready to dance his way into your heart! This little pup is tiny but mighty. When he's not snuggled in your arms, he's hopping around playfully. He's all ears and is happy to show them off by perking up and looking around.
Tuxedo is a little skinny right now and could use help gaining some weight. He also has a cleft palate, but that sure isn't slowing him down!
Tuxedo's ideal day is playing in the sunshine before a serious cuddle session. He'll be your loyal companion, cuddled right in your arms and observing the world.
Tuxedo joined us from San Jose Animal Care and Services after they determined his medical needs made him a better fit for our program.

dogs.name: Dr. Pepper
bio: Meet Dr. Pepper! A cool drink on a hot summer's day, Dr. Pepper is a calm pup, puttering around the yard or patio. He loves a short stroll about the neighborhood, then returning home to relax. Want to go on a longer walk? He loves riding in a stroller and taking in the scenery.
When there's lots going on, he's happy to calmly hang out without needing to be the center of attention. Being food-motivated, he'll be easier to train. This pup is the definition of easygoing!
Dr. Pepper came to POMDR from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after he was returned by his previous guardian. After bouncing around, he is ready to find his forever home!

dogs.name: Snorkel
bio: Snorkel is a true cuddle bug! Snorkel's bubbly personality will capture your heart in no time. He is a sweet and loving guy who adores people and wants to be loved and pampered in return!

Snorkel is happiest around humans. He loves curling up next to people and snoozing. He even lets his current foster's niece brush his hair! Snorkel can be a little shy when first meeting new people until he has a chance to sniff them, but he is quick to relax after that. While he is content to nap during the day, Snorkel is no couch potato! He is an active senior who happily goes for walks and rides in the car."Adventure" might as well be his middle name, as Snorkel is not afraid to go out and explore! Treats and belly rubs also top his favorites list. He does not mind cats or other dogs.
Snorkel prefers a home with constant attention, as he gets anxious when left alone. Due to hearing and vision loss, he would thrive with patience and TLC!
Snorkel joined POMDR from the Los Banos Animal Shelter after being found as a stray.

dogs.name: Ashanti
bio: Ashanti came to a local shelter after her elderly guardian suffered a fall and was unable to move for several days. When help finally arrived, they found Ashanti outside, without the care or resources she desperately needed. She was emaciated beyond belief, with painfully overgrown nails curling beneath her feet, swollen legs, severely damaged skin, and large areas of missing fur. On top of everything her body had endured, she was understandably frightened by this strange new world around her.

But beneath all of that neglect is a remarkably sweet girl who seems incredibly grateful for every gentle touch, kind word, and bit of care she receives. She is learning that hands can bring comfort, that meals will keep coming, and that she is finally safe. We can't wait to watch Ashanti blossom.

We know there is a beautiful dog waiting to emerge as her body heals and her confidence grows, but getting there will take time, patience, and a very special person. Ashanti is looking for an experienced home familiar with German Shepherds and with the patience to let her set the pace. Her adopter will need to be comfortable with the long game: allowing her to decompress, helping her learn what it means to be cared for, and celebrating the tiny victories along the way. She doesn't need someone looking for an instant best friend. She needs someone willing to earn her trust and walk beside her as she discovers the life she should have had all along.
Ashanti has already survived so much. Now she gets to learn what it feels like to be cherished. We have a feeling that watching this girl come back to life is going to be something pretty special.

dogs.name: Yankee Candle
bio: Meet Yankee Candle! This handsome little gentleman has perfected the finer things in life: leisurely strolls, cozy naps, soft blankets, and keeping a watchful eye on snack time. Yankee is basically a living, breathing four-legged candle: warm, comforting, charming, and guaranteed to make your home feel a little cozier.

His ideal retirement plan includes soft places to nap, a comfy lap or two, gentle strolls, plenty of love, and humans who appreciate the special magic of a senior dog. He gets along great with other dogs and is even a gentleman with kitties. If you're ready to add a little extra warmth, sweetness, and fluff to your life, Yankee Candle is ready to be your new favorite household fixture. No flame required.

Yankee Candle joined us after the San Jose Animal Care Center reached out to see if we could help him find the kind of peaceful, senior-focused home where he could truly enjoy his golden years. And honestly? We think this fluffy fellow deserves to be spoiled.

dogs.name: Watson
bio: Lovable little Watson is a tiny senior Chihuahua at his best. He may be getting along in years, but he still has some toddle left in those legs of his. He has a bit of osteoarthritis in his hips, but he doesn't let that slow him down at all. Aside from taking in the sights and smells around him, Watson loves a good sunbathing session. He'd love to lounge around the yard this summer with you!
Watson is lovely with cats and humans but prefers to be the only pup in the home. In his retirement years, he really just wants all of love for himself (and we understand!)!

Watson joined us from the Sacramento Bradshaw shelter where he landed after being found as a stray. They wanted to help him find a forever family ready to meet the needs of a senior dog, so he joined the POMDR family!

dogs.name: Bob Barker
bio: Come on down and meet Bob Barker, who turns everyone into a big lucky winner! With this pup, you will definitely hit the jackpot for good manners, mellow vibes, and lovable charm. Bob is super sweet, very independent, and he gets along with all people, other dogs, as well as cats, mainly by minding his own business. He might benefit from a tender canine companion in the home, but he would also be fine as a solo dog. No drama, no fuss, he just enjoys the simple pleasures of life and being by your side. One of his favorite activities is lying outside in the sun all day in a fluffy, cozy bed.

Bob never demands anything, and that is exactly why he deserves nothing less than to be mollycoddled, fussed over, and doted on from here on out. This guy is well aware that savoring his golden years with a loving forever family is priceless. The time is right to come on down, spin the big wheel, and adopt Bob Barker!
Sweet Bob came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being found as a stray.

dogs.name: Simba
bio: Simba is the kind of gentleman who makes an impression without ever asking for much. This sweet senior boy is polite, easygoing, good-natured, and wonderfully independent. He's happy to spend his days at a leisurely pace, enjoying the company of his people and taking in the world around him. Simba is also a polite pup with other dogs and does well sharing his space with canine friends. He has a calm, unassuming personality and seems perfectly content to simply be part of the family.

Simba was reportedly wandering around town as a stray for several weeks before finally making his way to the shelter. Considering this gentleman is fairly slow-moving and very much enjoys life at his own pace, we're not quite sure how he managed to become such a seasoned neighborhood explorer! What we do know is that Simba is a really lovely boy who deserves a comfortable place to call home. We think he would do best in a home with other dogs. If you're looking for a sweet, polite, low-key companion who doesn't need much fanfare to be happy, Simba might be your guy. He's ready to leave his wandering days behind and settle into a forever home where he can finally put his paws up and enjoy the good life.

Little Simba joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray. Due to the shelter's full status and his senior age, they felt he would do best to join a senior focused rescue to land in his loving forever home.

dogs.name: Timon
bio: Who loves to play, bask in the sunshine, and give world-class snuggles? Timon! This curious and affectionate little guy likes to be right in the middle of life. He loves people, happily curls up on a welcoming lap, and is always ready for pets, playtime, or a good adventure. He's a big fan of toys - chasing them, playing fetch, or entertaining himself with a particularly satisfying shake - and his foster says his funny expressions make him even more lovable. At home, he's a mellow sunbather and champion snuggler, but take him to the beach and he's ready to go!

Timon is missing a front leg, but you wouldn't know it from his enthusiasm for walks, outings, and exploring the world. This athletic little tripod has adapted beautifully and hasn't let it slow him down. He would love a home where he can get plenty of affection, activity, and time with his people. Timon would shine as an only dog or with calm and patient pups in a cat-free home.

Timon came to POMDR after being found as a stray and brought to Hitchcock Road Animal Services. Due to a severe mass on his leg, he was brought to POMDR for emergency treatment. Now, he's looking for a forever home where he can keep doing what he does best: loving his people and making the most of every day.

dogs.name: Relish
bio: Relish is a bright spark of personality with just the right amount of zest to match her name. She has a curious, attentive nature and a sweet little presence that makes her easy to root for from the moment you meet her.

Relish enjoys being near her people, finding cozy spots to tuck into, and taking in the world with quiet interest. She's the kind of small dog who settles in and quickly becomes part of the rhythm of the home. Relish would prefer a quiet home without too much going on and would benefit from a patient family helping her find her new rhythm after raising three lovely puppies.

After arriving from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento, where she came in as a stray, we discovered that Relish was pregnant! She has now raised her little ones and is ready to find her forever family and be pampered like the princess that she is!

dogs.name: Jasper
bio: Charming, handsome, and a true gentleman - what more could you want? Jasper checks all those boxes and much more! He is a friendly, well-mannered, and adorable Chihuahua mix who is eager to find his forever home.

Jasper has a heart of gold and loves people! Jasper currently lives with teenagers, and his foster believes he would do well in a home with younger children. Jasper is a fearless and outgoing little guy who loves meeting new people and is friendly towards other dogs!

Although he's not bouncing off the walls with energy, Jasper does enjoy afternoon walks and does well on a leash. He also loves riding in the car! He enjoys cuddling and unabashedly follows people around seeking attention! He'll also do best in a home where someone can show him a routine as he settles in!
Jasper came to us from Bradshaw Animal Shelter in Sacramento due to his senior status.

dogs.name: Charlie
bio: This handsome German Shepherd mix may be blind, but he certainly doesn't let that slow him down! Charlie is a sweet, loving boy who gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is ready to fill his forever home with companionship, cuddles, and plenty of tail wags. His biggest wish is simple: a loving family who will see what a special boy he truly is.

Charlie is looking for a home without stairs where he can feel safe, comfortable, and confident as he navigates his world. If you have room in your heart for a one-of-a-kind pup who has so much love to give, Charlie could be your perfect match. Give this amazing boy a chance to shine!
Charlie came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being found as a stray.

dogs.name: Pumba
bio: Tiny guy, maximum charm: Pumba is a little gentleman with an unforgettable face and a personality that makes a big impression. Sweet, affectionate, and wonderfully endearing, he's the kind of dog who can brighten a room simply by being in it. Pumba is ready for a home of his own, complete with cozy naps, gentle adventures, and a favorite person to adore.

This little guy is perfectly suited for someone looking for a loyal companion in a very portable package. He's the kind of dog who'll tuck in beside you on the couch, tag along for the day, and generally make ordinary life a lot more entertaining simply by being there. And yes, those ears are every bit as magnificent as they look.

Pumba came to POMDR from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after being found as a stray. Now this one-of-a-kind fellow is ready for his next chapter, and a home where he can settle in as someone�s beloved sidekick!

dogs.name: Spaghetti
bio: What's more comforting than Spaghetti? This gentle girl is as sweet as can be! At 40 pounds, she might seem big to be a lap dog, but she doesn't think so! Like a true English Bulldog, she's not going anywhere fast. She's mellow and all smiles.
She is great with dogs and greets all people with a big, happy smile. All she wants is a good friend and happy home.
Spaghetti joins her dear friend Meatball (also in our program) from the SPCA of Monterey County due to her medical needs.

dogs.name: Tiny Dancer
bio: Tiny Dancer is the definition of gentle. He has a calm, mellow spirit that instantly puts people at ease, and he's happiest simply being near the people he loves. He's the kind of dog who doesn't ask for much -- just a cozy bed, a few kind words, and someone to share life's quiet moments.

This sweet little gentleman is deaf and may be missing his lower jaw, but he hasn't let it steal an ounce of his charm. In fact, it's just one more thing that makes him completely unforgettable. Every little expression, every happy wag, and every soft look reminds you that perfection comes in all shapes, sizes, and smiles. Tiny Dancer is living proof that the things that make us different are often the things that make us the most lovable. He's resilient, incredibly sweet, and full of personality. Tiny Dancer loves treats and being pushed in his stroller, though he is learning to walk well on leash. This little guy is also great with dogs of all sizes.
Whether he's toddling alongside you, soaking up affection, or simply keeping you company, he has a way of making ordinary days feel a little more special.

Tiny Dancer joined us from the Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire after he was found as a stray. Due to his senior status and their overcrowded shelter, they felt he would do best in a senior-focused rescue.

dogs.name: Tang
bio: Looking to add a splash of sweetness to your life? Meet Tang, a charming senior fellow who's guaranteed to brighten your day! This handsome guy is great with other dogs and always seems ready to make a new friend. He is always happy to meet dogs, and when he's a little excited, he is easily redirected. His pep truly shows when he's about to go on a walk. The rest of his time, he's a mellow guy. Whether he's hanging out with his canine pals, exploring the world on a walk, or curling up after a day of fun, he brings just the right amount of zest wherever he goes.

He doesn't usually play with toys, though he may snuggle with them in bed! He loves to be with his favorite people and is a good travel companion! If you're searching for a loyal companion with plenty of charm and a heart full of sweetness, Tang may be just the flavor you've been looking for. Come meet this citrusy cutie and see why everyone who meets him finds him simply irresistible!
Tang joined us from The Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire. Due to overcrowding, they reached out in hopes that we could help find space for a few of the incredible seniors in their care.

dogs.name: Praline
bio: If you are looking for a sweet treat without the extra sugar and calories, then this Praline is made for you! Praline is a mellow and gentle soul who is looking for lots of affection, yummy treats, and a calm, peaceful home where she can enjoy a slower pace of life. Get comfortable on the sofa with a good book in your hand, and this little delight will be happy to curl up next to you. When it is feeding time, she will perk right up and perform a little twirly dance on her back feet. For bedtime, she loves to be under the blankets snuggled up by your side. She is happiest when she can be near the people she loves all day, every day. Before joining our program, she did not get a chance to live life to the fullest, and she is eager to catch up on the plush, pampered poodle lifestyle.

At her foster home, Praline gets along well with her canine siblings, even sharing a bed with dogs much larger than her! She prefers gentle, calm dogs that respect her personal space, speed, and size. She is a perfect car-ride companion, either looking out the window or snoozing in her seat. At home, she is fully house-trained and low maintenance. She would do best in a house without stairs, or where she can be carried up and down stairs, due to some mobility and vision limitations. This little survivor had a complete mastectomy and is currently on Meloxicam.

Praline joined us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after she was found as a stray. Due to her senior status and her need for medical attention, they reached out to find her the perfect retirement home. Praline's ideal day is sitting by the open door, snuggled by your side as you enjoy a good book. If you're looking for a gentle soul to share your days with, Praline may be the perfect match.

dogs.name: Malibu
bio: Malibu is ready for summer beach time! Malibu's temperament is a wonderful balance of playful and mellow. She's a great house guest and is content relaxing on her dog bed while you're away. If you're searching for a gentle, affectionate companion with a heart as big as the ocean, Malibu is ready to make a splash in your life.

Malibu returned to our care when her guardian was no longer able to care for her. This sweet girl has some chronic medical conditions, so her adopters should be prepared to manage and monitor her ongoing care.

dogs.name: Strawberry
bio: Meet Strawberry, a sweet and lovable pup with a heart as bright as her name! This charming girl is ready to wiggle her way into your life with her gentle personality and adorable presence. Strawberry is the kind of dog who brings a little extra sunshine wherever she goes.

Strawberry is a wonderful companion who gets along well with other dogs and enjoys having furry friends around. She has a medium to low energy level, making her a great match for someone looking for a relaxed buddy who is happy to go for a stroll, share some snuggles, and enjoy the simple things in life.

If you're looking for a sweet-natured girl who will fill your days with love, loyalty, and plenty of tail wags, Strawberry may be your perfect match. She's ready to find her forever family and start her next chapter!
Strawberry joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after after her guardian lost their housing.

dogs.name: Puffin
bio: Tiny and full of charm, Puffin is a sweet little Yorkie looking for a soft place to land. This adorable senior has a gentle soul, a cute little tongue that loves to peek out, and a face that's impossible to resist. He's happiest soaking up attention, enjoying cozy naps, and simply being near his people. If you're looking for a pint-sized best friend to brighten your days, Puffin is ready to waddle right into your heart.
Puffin came to us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after his guardian could no longer care for him.

dogs.name: Axel
bio: Axel is a handsome large-breed gentleman who has so much love to give. With his sweet personality, loyal nature, and lovable presence, he's the kind of dog who makes every day feel a little brighter. Whether he's soaking up attention, enjoying time with his people, or showing off his charming personality, Axel is ready to be someone's best friend.

This gentle giant is hoping to find a forever home where he can be loved, appreciated, and included as part of the family. If you've been searching for a devoted companion with a whole lot of heart, Axel may be the perfect match. Axel would do best in a home without cats and small children.

Big dogs have a special way of filling a home with comfort, companionship, and endless love. Axel is ready to prove just how wonderful a big-hearted buddy can be. Give this sweet boy a chance, and he just might become the loyal, loving friend you've been waiting for.
Axel joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Shelter after he was picked up as a stray.

dogs.name: Otter
bio: Meet Otter, a sweet little gentleman with a big heart and a serious appreciation for naps, snacks, and being close to his favorite person! Otter is a low-energy, affectionate guy who spends about 80% of his day happily snoozing. He's house-trained, rarely barks, and communicates mostly through adorable little whines when he wants attention or isn't feeling his best. He loves following his person around and is happiest when he can be picked up and tucked beside you on the sofa. Once you stop snuggling him, don't be surprised if he gently puts his head on your chest to request more!

Otter is a bit shy and has weak rear legs, so he isn't a candidate for long walks or a high-energy lifestyle. He enjoys leisurely strolls, happily says hello to dogs and people he meets, and then is perfectly content to continue on his way. Because his back legs tire easily, he may drag his rear paws and scrape them after walking for a while, and he needs to be carried up and down steps. He has a wonderfully laid-back attitude toward the world and is also quite comfortable in the car, where he'll simply sit or lie down for the ride.

This little guy has plenty of personality, too! He loves treats so much that they can even be added to his meals, and sometimes he enjoys being spoon-fed. He doesn't have much interest in traditional toys, but he does occasionally toss his doggy bed around and burrow underneath it. He gets along well with other animals, showing some polite curiosity before deciding they're really not all that interesting. He's also happy to meet new people and should do well with respectful children.

Otter's ideal home is a quiet one with someone who has plenty of time and affection to give. He doesn't need a busy schedule or lots of exercise - he'd much rather spend the day beside his person, take a gentle midday walk, enjoy some treats, and curl up on the couch. He does get excited when his person returns home and may howl until he settles down, but once he's calm, he's back to his favorite activities: following you, snuggling, and napping.

Otter is a special little guy looking for a special person who understands that his slower pace and weak back legs are simply part of who he is. In return, he'll give you endless companionship, sweet kisses, hilarious quirks, and a whole lot of love. If your idea of the perfect day involves a cozy couch, a devoted little shadow, plenty of affection, and maybe a few treats from the refrigerator, Otter may be your perfect match!
Otter comes to us from the Monterey SPCA after his guardian passed away.

dogs.name: Jackie
bio: Meet Jackie, a spirited senior girl with a heart as big as her personality. Don't let her age fool you; this girl still has plenty of pep in her step. She does equally well with a 20 minute sniff-n-stroll around the neighborhood as with a 3 mile hike. She is no slouch on trail and keeps up a good clip when she's in the mood. Jackie is great on leash and wonderfully responsive to treats.

Jackie gets periodic zoomies and adores an interactive play session with her people. The game is dealer's choice; tug (she will graciously keep shoving your end of the toy back into your hand), chase-and-be-chase, Wrestlemania, she's up for pretty much anything. She does use her mouth in a playful way when the game is afoot but is responsive to redirection. Her house manners are impeccable, housetrained, and OK being left home alone when necessary.

Jackie's feelings about other dogs vary. She lives very well with her part time foster sister - a street-smart senior Chihuahua and is relatively indifferent to most other dogs but she doesn't suffer fools and is not a fan of big, over-eager youngins. As a general rule, she seems to prefer small dogs to dogs her own size. She would love to play with the Chihuahua in the house, but her tactile, enthusiastic play style combined with the size differential and the Chi's age make it an unrequited love.

She is surprisingly easy on leash for such a big, strong dog, but will do best with someone comfortable handling her size and strength, especially during those moments when her inner puppy emerges. Jackie was reportedly crate trained in her previous home but is never crated in her foster home and is the perfect housemate. She made an amazingly smooth transition to her foster home and is primed to do the same for her adopters. If you're looking for a loyal, lively companion who's equal parts affectionate, self-contained, and adventurous, Jackie might be your perfect match.

Jackie joined the POMDR pack because one of her loving guardians has dementia and is moving into assisted living. Sadly, they can't take her with them. This sweet, silly girl is looking for someone to swoop in, scoop her up, and show her that she has many more years of love ahead of her!

dogs.name: Funyun
bio: Funyun is proof that the best things come in crispy little packages. This lovable senior Yorkie has been through more than his fair share of life's layers, arriving in our care with neglected skin and limited sight. (He's also likely deaf). But underneath it all is one incredibly sweet guy who simply wants a cozy bed, gentle pets, and someone to love.
Funyun is looking for a compassionate foster or adopter who can help him leave the past behind and enjoy all the comforts he's always deserved.

dogs.name: Onion Ring
bio: A tasty treat doesn't get much better than an onion ring! Our boy Onion Ring is full of pep, loves exploring, and is always ready to greet you with a wagging tail or trot alongside you for a stroll. He's the perfect blend of playful and easygoing, happy to join in on the fun before settling in for some well-earned cuddle time.

Onion Ring is a social little guy who gets along wonderfully with other dogs and absolutely adores people. Whether he's making new friends on a walk or curling up beside you on the couch, he's happiest when he's part of the action.

His foster reports "Onion Ring is so cute. He is friendly, cuddly, good with other dogs and cats. He likes to sleep on the bed day or night, especially near his "person." Gives the big hello. House trained. He doesn't have any teeth."
Onion Ring joined us from Hollister Animal Services where he was found as a stray.

dogs.name: Mayo
bio: Meet Mayo, a black and white Chihuahua mix with a soft, easy charm and just the right amount of mellow sweetness to match his name. He has a gentle, observant nature and tends to take in the world quietly before settling in close to his person.
Mayo enjoys cozy spots, calm companionship, and the comfort of being near someone he trusts. He's the kind of little dog who becomes a steady, sweet presence once he feels at home.

His foster reports "Mayo is very sociable. So happy to see my whenever I come back, even if it is the other end of the house. He likes to sleep on the bed day or night. likes to be next to his "person." likes to be petted. Good around other dogs and cats. House trained and no medication."
Mayo came to us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after he was picked up as a stray.

dogs.name: Gumdrop
bio: Meet Gumdrop, the sweetest little treat you'll ever meet! This adorable English Bulldog is all about love, snuggles, and soaking up every bit of attention she can get. She has the softest heart and will happily curl up next to you for naps, belly rubs, and lazy afternoons. But don't be fooled -- this sweet girl has a lot of energy and would love an active household!

Gumdrop does great with other dogs and loves having canine friends to hang out with. She would prefer a home without cats (she thinks they're just too mysterious!). If you're looking for a loyal, cuddly companion who will fill your days with joy, love, and bulldog charm, Gumdrop is your girl!
Gumdrop joined us from Contra Costa Animal Services.

dogs.name: Nougat
bio: Nougat is a sweet little guy with a real talent for finding the best seat in the house - usually right next to you, or preferably in your lap! Affectionate, social, and easygoing, he loves being close to his people and is always happy to welcome a little extra attention. He enjoys meeting new people, is always happy to soak up some affection, and has soulful eyes that are nearly impossible to resist.

When he is not busy perfecting his couch-companion skills, Nougat enjoys daily walks and does nicely on leash. He is friendly when meeting other dogs and has an adaptable personality that could fit comfortably into many different kinds of homes. He is equally content heading out for a stroll or settling in for a cozy afternoon with his favorite person.

Nougat was found as a stray and brought to Santa Clara County Animal Services. The shelter reached out to POMDR to help this senior gentleman find the right home for his next chapter. Now he's ready to settle in, find his favorite lap, and make himself very much at home.

dogs.name: Casper
bio: Meet Casper, the friendly pup! This senior lad is full of energy and loves to play with toys. He is a joyful guy with a big heart who is happy to tag along wherever you go. Sadly, Casper was recently diagnosed with lymphoma. Without treatment, his prognosis is only a few months to live. We are choosing to give him the best chance possible, so he is undergoing cancer treatment at a specialist in the Monterey area. Based on his energy and enthusiasm, you would never know he is fighting a serious illness! If his adopters are willing to continue bringing him to treatment appointments in Monterey post-adoption, POMDR will cover the cost of his treatment (approx. 288 days).

While Casper is very friendly and social, he is working on resource guarding from both people and other dogs. While he does well with his foster pup sibling, we think he would also love to be an only dog where he doesn't have to share his toys. Casper does great around cats. He is looking for a forever home where he can float right into your heart (and toy bin).
Handsome Casper joined us from the Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire. He was brought in as a stray. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best in a senior focused rescue.

dogs.name: Bumper Car
bio: Bumper Car is just the perfect blend of sweet and spunky! Bumper Car may be blind, but she sees the world with her heart- and what a big, beautiful heart it is. Whether she's following the sound of your voice or curling up beside you for snuggles, Bumper Car is all about connection. Despite her vision loss, she's a confident little navigator who quickly learns her surroundings. Her sense of smell and hearing are top-notch, and she uses them like a pro to explore, adapt, and find her favorite cozy spots.

She gets along beautifully with other dogs and cats, and her gentle energy makes her a joy to be around. If you're looking for a lovable sidekick who will warm your heart, make you laugh, and remind you daily that joy has no limits -Bumper Car is your girl.

Bumper Car came to us from the Sacramento Animal Shelter after being found as a stray, but you'd never guess her past by her joyful spirit. She's already left the shelter life in her past and is ready to settle into a forever home where she'll be cherished for the sweet little treasure she is.

dogs.name: Jamesy Boy
bio: Jamesy Boy is a tiny gentleman with a soft spirit and the sweetest gray muzzle. During the day, Jamsey will be your constant buddy. He loves to follow his foster parent around the house, but knows how to stay out of the way of your feet! He is a super cuddly boy who sleeps through the night and even does well when left home alone.

Despite his age, Jamesy Boy still has plenty of pep for a gentle walk and perks right up when treats or affection are on the menu. He is polite, easy to please, and grateful for every bit of kindness shown to him. This little guy has known some tough days, but his resilience and tenderness shine through every time he nudges your hand for pets. Jamesy will also gladly hang out in a pouch or sling and would love to go on adventures this way! Jamesy does excellently with other dogs, he is a respectful and confident member of the pack in his foster home!
Darling Jamesy Boy joined us from the Contra Costa Animal Shelter when they reached out for placement with a senior focused rescue.

dogs.name: Huey
bio: Huey is an old soul who has mastered the art of being a very goodest of boys. Sweet Huey joined us from the Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire after he was found as a stray. Due to their over full shelter, they felt he would to best in the hands of a rescue that could help ensure he landed in the right adoptive home.

Sadly, shortly after his arrival with us, Huey's health began to decline. After a few emergency vet visits and testing, his medical team suspect an intestinal cancer is the reason for the decline. We're so grateful that Huey has the support of our vet team and his loving foster home to meet his needs in this challenging time where he will remain for the rest of his days.Please consider [[sponsoring Huey's forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Huey]]

dogs.name: Gigi (aka Spork)
bio: Sweet little miss Spork- or Gigi as her hospice foster calls her, joined us from San Jose Animal Care Center and Services after she was found wandering the streets as a stray, due to her severe medical needs they thought she would shine best in a senior-focused rescue and they were not wrong. She quickly became a staff favorite upon arrival and has found a loving landing spot in her hospice-foster's home.

While in our program, we found Spork to need liver support, have Cushing's disease, kidney disease, and to have a heart murmur.
