Due to the medical support that she needs daily, we found it best to make her a permanent POMDR pup to reside in her loving foster home.Please consider [[sponsoring Gigi (aka Spork)'s forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Gigi (aka Spork)]]

dogs.name: Winkle
bio: Sweet Winkle came to POMDR from another rescue group when they discovered that his medical needs were more than they could handle. Senior dogs like Winkle with senior-related issues are our specialty so we were happy to bring him into our program. As time has gone by, Winkle developed cataracts and has lost most of his vision. It seems his senior years have caught up to him as well as he has been experiencing some doggie dementia.

Luckily Winkle hit the jackpot with a loving foster mom able to tend to his needs and wonderful furry foster siblings to support him. Winkle will live out his time with all of the love and support he could ask for.Please consider [[sponsoring Winkle's forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Winkle]]

dogs.name: Snowflake
bio: Sweet little Snowflake is every bit as unique and dainty as her name suggests. This special senior lady came to Peace of Mind after being picked up as a stray by Hitchcock Road Animal Services in Salinas.

Once in our care, Snowflake was found to have some significant medical needs, including arthritis, multiple heart conditions, and ongoing eye care. Thankfully, this little lady hit the jackpot when she found a loving foster family who welcomed her with open arms and were happy to give her the comfort and care she deserved in her golden years. Given her medical needs, they knew she deserved a place where she could stay comfortable, cherished, and well cared for for the rest of her life. So, along with her beloved guinea pig sibling, Milkshake, Snowflake is officially home for good.
Please consider [[sponsoring Snowflake's forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Snowflake]]

dogs.name: Zelda
bio: Sweet Zelda came to POMDR from Santa Clara County Animal Services after her guardian sadly was hospitalized and unable to care for her.
In her time with POMDR, Zelda has proven herself to be tiny but mighty. She loves being carried by her foster mom and is always content to toddle around the yard in the sun.

Zelda came to us with one of her eyes needing to be removed and a heart murmur. Sadly in time she has declined and her heart murmur has worsened, her arthritis has become more prominent and she has developed the early stages of kidney disease. Due to her medical needs, her loving foster has decided to be her forever landing spot to continue to support her senior needs.Please consider [[sponsoring Zelda's forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Zelda]]

dogs.name: Suki
bio: Suki's name comes from the Japanese word for loved one, and it fits her perfectly. This sweet girl has a gentle, mellow soul and a calm presence that makes you want to sit beside her and tell her everything will be okay.

Sweet Suki joins us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after she was found as a stray. Upon arrival it was clear that she needed some additional TLC and a special landing spot. We're so grateful that she found her hospice-foster extraordinaire to meet her higher medical needs.Please consider [[sponsoring Suki's forever care.|POMDRSponsorDog.php?petname=Suki]]

dogs.name: Obi
bio: Sweet Obi is a 7-year-old terrier mix, about 14 lbs. Obi is mostly a homebody. Mellow and quiet, he loves cozying up in blankets all day and enjoys snuggles and cuddles. Once he forms a connection, he becomes very lovey-dovey. Short walks or hikes in quiet areas are his favorite, especially when he gets to sniff everything at his own pace. He doesn't need much exercise and isn't a high-energy dog, so working from home with him close by is easy and distraction-free.

Food is a huge motivator for him. He's the kind of dog who won't refuse a meal, even when he's not feeling well. Kongs and rodent-shaped stuffed animals are his favorite toys. He knows all the main commands (sit, jump, come, wait, stay, relax, crate, etc.) and is fully house-trained. Although he has separation anxiety and can be protective of his parents, he's also been incredibly brave and smart, making real progress in facing his fears. He deserves the chance to keep healing and building confidence.
If you are interested in learning more about Obi, please contact Andrea at 669-240-6425 or by email at [[[email protected]|/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection]]

dogs.name: Birka
bio: Birka has been described as sweet and smart! She's a sharp and very loving girl. Whether you are looking for a morning walking companion or a snuggle buddy on the couch, Birka is your girl! She loves all people, including children! A proper lady, she's great on leash and knows her basic obedience. She is also crate trained! With her previous guardian, she would go to work, lighting up the day for everyone who saw her.
Birka's one request is that she go to a home with no cats--she gets a little too excited by them! To learn more about Birka, reach out to Robert at: [[[email protected]|/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection]]

dogs.name: Chimmu
bio: This incredibly gorgeous boy is none other than Chimmu! He's an Indian Pariah / Retriever/ Whippet Mix. who is about 4 years and around 40lbs. This special guy was rescued along with his momma from the streets of India by their loving foster but with many dogs of her own, she is looking for that perfect landing spot for these great pups. Because of his rough past he is a bit scared when new people come to the house or when seeing unknown dogs out in the world.
If you'd like to learn more about Chimmu please contact Morella at 415-858-9731 or by email at [[[email protected]|/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#fab795889f96969b98ba9b9596d4999597]].

dogs.name: Chikki
bio: "I'm tired of living with 5 other dogs that we don't get along. Please help my foster Mom she loves me so much but she needs to find me a loving quiet home without other doggies nor cats." - Chikki

Chikki is 6 years old and she is better sweet. She was rescued from the streets of India where she gave birth to 4 puppies who were all adopted except Chimmu. You can see her scars on her face from fighting with monkey. to survive and keep her puppies safe. She would thrive in a quiet home with no other pets nor small children
If you'd like to learn more about Chikki please contact Morella at 415-858-9731 or by email at [[[email protected]|/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2964465b4c4545484b69484645074a4644]].

dogs.name: Gypsy
bio: Gypsy is a Shepherd mix looking for a new home after her guardian sadly passed away. This lovely girl is estimated to be four years old and approximately 50lbs. She is comfortable alone and with dogs. She happened to find her previous guardian by wandering onto their property, and she's now ready for her next adventure--wandering into your heart! Gypsy is house and crate trained and knows all her basic commands! She is spayed and has all her vaccinations completed.
If you'd like to learn more about Gypsy, reach out to Annette at (408) 921-1534.

dogs.name: Bailey Bae
bio: Bailey is a beautiful, affectionate gal with the most loving big brown eyes, a smile that wins people over instantly, and with her playful energy, most people are shocked to hear she's 9. She loves daily walks, cuddle time, and being close to her person. She is 30 lbs. and working toward her ideal weight of around 24 lbs., where she'll truly be feeling her best, and naturally long-haired but groomed every few months.
You can find her on Instagram at @its_baileybae.

She is very smart and familiar with her basic commands, including sit, stay, come, leave it, shake (left and right!), and spin. Bailey loves 2 walks a day, but is happy with one solid outing -- whether that's a neighborhood walk, a hike (she can comfortably cover several miles), or a trip to the beach (she's not a water girl, which conveniently keeps her clean!). Bonus points if she spots a lizard to chase or gopher holes to investigate. And don't let her age fool you -- get her going with a squeaky toy and she plays like a puppy.

Bailey requires a child-free home where she can feel safe, relaxed, and fully herself. She is fearful and reactive around young children, so a home without them is a must. She also truly shines as the only pet -- no competing for attention, just all the love directed at her. She would thrive with someone (or a couple) who can give her plenty of company, whether that's a retiree, someone who works from home, or a person who can bring her along to work.
If you'd like to learn more about Bailey, please contact Michelle at (408) 250-4422

dogs.name: Luna
bio: Luna a 9-year-old rat terrier ready to seek out her next adventure. She is 19lbs of personality! When meeting new people, she likes to take her time, but soon after, her friendly personality shines through! That being said, she is not very fond of children and would prefer an adult-only household. She also loves to chase cats and would do best without cats.

She is fine with other dogs, though she prefers to have her space and do her own thing--a truly independent lady! And like a true lady, she is house-trained, crate-trained, walks well on leash, and knows her basic commands. Best of all, she has no separation anxiety.
If you are interested in learning more about Luna, please contact Tiffanie at: (707) 888-7406

dogs.name: Wilson and Walter
bio: What's better than one pup? Two! Wilson and Walter are a bonded pair of senior boys looking for a home where they can spend their golden years together. Wilson is a 13-year-old Dachshund mix, and Walter is a 11-year-old Yorkie/Jack Russell Terrier mix - between the two of them, they've got a whole lot of love and a whole lot of personality. They are crate trained, walk well on leash, and do well with people and other dogs. Wilson is the laid-back one who's happy to follow your lead, while Walter brings a little extra spunk to the duo. These two have been together their whole lives, and they're hoping to find someone who will keep it that way.
For more information about Wilson and Walter, please contact Teresa at (831) 706-1576 or Kelly at (828) 337-1765.

dogs.name: Appa
bio: Appa is a friendly, quiet, and smart 90 pound German Shepard, husky mix. He is 5 year old love bug who gets along great with dogs, cats and even bunnies! He is calm and patient with children and understands the "relax" command. He is house trained, crate trained and knows all his basic commands well (sit, stay, down etc.) and walks well on leash. He does well when left alone but would love to accompany you on your weekend hikes, daily runs or coffee dates!
If Appa sounds like the perfect new addition to your family and you would like more information, please contact Ana at [[[email protected]|/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection]].
